name: gradient-north-miracle

frames.best_why: Frame 1 holds the full panel with both the hot magenta top and the cyan base unclipped.

tagline: Neon magenta pouring down into electric cyan.
summary: A loud two-colour gradient block: vivid magenta across the top sliding into bright cyan at the bottom, shaped as a wide rounded rectangle for use behind content.
appearance: A wide rounded rectangle on a dark stage, painted with a saturated vertical blend. Bright magenta fills the upper half and fades through violet into a glowing cyan along the bottom edge.
behaviour: Static: nothing moves or responds; all frames show the same blend.
search_phrases: electric blue and hot pink wash
use_when: A bold, high-energy colour field is wanted behind a launch, event or music page.
avoid_when: Its very bright saturated stops fight small text and calmer editorial layouts.
customise: Size and extra styles come through className and style; the magenta and cyan stops are hardcoded.
weight_why: One div painted with a CSS gradient; nothing animates.

a11y.note: Decorative gradient only, so there is nothing to operate, focus or read aloud.

issues: Frames show an inset rounded card, contradicting the packet's full-bleed footprint note.
polish_why: Smooth even blend and clean corners; the palette is bold but generic.
title: North Miracle
